messages:
samir: NimbusHealth (acct:nimbus-123) just pinged support — they say invoice INV-2026-047 includes a burst line thats roughly double what our usage export shows. Can finance take a look? :frowning:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-047 created 2026-03-29T08:12Z  total_due $18,450  https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-047
natalie: Contract: 50k committed tokens/month. Our pre-bill export shows ~180k total tokens for period → 130k burst billed. Customers PDF shows burst quantity ~260k tokens. That mismatch smells like duplicate events.
eli: grabbing raw events now. early sign: the burst ingestion pipeline retried acks across two consumer partitions during a transient DB timeout. sample sanitized rows below:
```
# sanitized usage events
2026-03-29T07:59:02Z,nimbus-123,burst,130000,event_id=evt-9a1b
2026-03-29T07:59:05Z,nimbus-123,burst,130000,event_id=evt-9a1b  # same event_id repeated due to retry
```
eli: looks like non-idempotent writes created duplicate billing lines. I can reprocess after dedupe and produce corrected CSV to s3 by EOD.
mara: Ok. Hold collections on INV-2026-047 until we confirm. Proposed provisional credit $7,200 to offset the erroneous overage (est). Any credit > $5k needs finance lead sign-off. @samir please notify customer were investigating and will issue a proforma credit note.
samir: On it. I will message NimbusHealth now: "Were pausing payment collection while we correct an issue in our billing export. Youll get a proforma credit and corrected invoice within 48h"
natalie: Customer procurement asked for a credit memo they can present internally. Ill draft one but will wait for final approval and the corrected export.
eli: mitigation done: restarted billing-processor deployment (kubectl rollout restart deploy/billing-processor -n prod) and deployed an idempotency fix. Ill reprocess with event_id dedupe and upload corrected file → s3://billing-exports/2026-03/nimbus-123/corrected-INV-2026-047.csv
mara: Approve provisional hold and provisional credit $7,200 pending final recon. Finance, please create ledger hold GC-2026-049 and block collections on that invoice.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-047 status -> credit_pending; ticket TICKET-5324 created.
mara: Thanks all. Once the corrected export is in and we reconcile token counts, finance will post the final credit and reissue the invoice. Natalie, keep NimbusHealth updated and aim to close in 48h. :thumbsup:
